title: fix(ui): show configured agent avatars in owner menus
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes agent entries in the session owner dropdown showing a generated face instead of the agent’s configured avatar (for example, Kitsune’s fox).

## User Impact

Owner and participant faces now use the agent’s configured emoji or image, consistently with the navigation rail. Agents without a configured avatar keep their generated face. No migration or configuration change is needed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared participant renderer only consumed the session actor’s image URL, losing text avatars. It now reads the existing reactive agent roster and hydrated identity, using the existing avatar resolvers without adding requests or a cache. Emoji faces also avoid inheriting the tiny initials font size.

Simplification: one shared fix covers the owner picker and participant faces; no picker-specific renderer or protocol field. Production delta: +28 net lines; regression coverage: +37 lines.

Reported by and co-authored with @vincentkoc.

## Work sessions

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/c4738283-1f71-47e8-9218-840464038d73)

## Evidence

- Reproduced the missing fox through the owner-avatar component before the fix; the regression failed with an absent emoji.
- `pnpm test ui/src/components/viewer-facepile.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 18 passing tests, 1.80 seconds wall time (0.22 seconds test time). Hosted UI shards and the executed browser E2E check passed; per-file CI timing is not separately reported.
- UI typecheck, focused lint/format, and production UI build passed. Independent autoreview found no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Mock-Gateway browser proof opens the actual owner dropdown and checks the generated face before / configured fox after. This is synthetic UI proof, not a live Gateway deployment.

### Hosted CI disposition

Run [38866341702](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38866341702), attempt 1, failed only check-lint-core-2 and its aggregate gate: unchanged ui/src/pages/debug/debug-overlay.tsx:115 violates typescript(consistent-return). The same type-aware lint failure reproduces locally independently of the avatar files. Baseline and tested-merge blobs match for that file, lint config, and dependency pins. The automated report calls it new relative to an earlier scheduled run; source-level qualification establishes that it predates this PR. Repair is already tracked in [#173976](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173976). The native inherited-failure exception was refused because the writer cannot read classic branch-protection policy. The original auto request was retired, and the landed lint repair (8425c9a0cf88) was integrated for ordinary green-CI landing. The avatar patch is unchanged. Replacement head 96372ca08506 passed [CI run 38868526932](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38868526932), and native ordinary recovery merged it as 93fc6c3ca6bc. No CI exception was used. After integration, all 18 focused tests passed again (2.43 seconds wall time), as did UI typecheck and the formerly failing lint.
